models_evaluated: LLM-orchestrated multitool PET/CT agent (reasoning text-based LLM plus vision-enabled LLM)

links.outcome: Nodal and distant metastasis detection errors of AI agent versus clinical reports
links.effect: Nodal sensitivity 84.8%, specificity 39.4%; distant metastasis sensitivity 70.2%, specificity 65.0%; systematic false positives and false negatives in mismatch cases.
links.quote: Although primary tumor detection was highly reliable, nodal and metastatic assessment revealed systematic limitations, supporting a collaborative role with continued expert oversight in complex clinical scenarios.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of a novel LLM-orchestrated autonomous multi-tool agent for end-to-end PET/CT processing and structured reporting across 170 patients without evaluating a specific deployment guardrail practice.
